subject: [hw] V12 -> V02: full tested diff for a32_route (case 0/1/3 + F4-F7), apply verbatim
body:
Follow-up to my previous message: here is the complete unified diff I built and tested in /tmp (private copy; I did not touch your file). It also fixes the -Werror issue that follows from it: change the declaration `unsigned group, op, hi, op2, cp;` to `unsigned group, op2, cp;` because op/hi become unused.

Tested with T01 asmrun against the patched core (clang -O2, all emu sources, weak fallbacks for V16-V20):
  push/mov/pop prologue -> RETURN; ldr r1,[r0],r2 -> ok; ldrh r1,[r0,#-2] -> ok;
  ldrd r2,r3,[r0],#8 -> ok; strd r2,r3,[r0,#-8]! -> ok; pldw [r0] -> ok;
  wfe/sev/yield/dbg #0 -> ok.

```diff
--- gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_core.c	2026-11-11 11:35:15.043364524 +0100
+++ /tmp/n2hw-v12/patched/n2a32_core.c	2026-11-11 11:49:24.141806936 +0100
@@ -243,40 +243,40 @@
 	if (cond != 0xFu) {
 		group = (insn >> 25) & 7u;
 		switch (group) {
-		case 0:                          /* data processing register and miscellaneous */
-			op = (insn >> 20) & 0x1Fu;
-			if ((op & 0x10u) != 0) { /* bit 24 */
-				hi = op & 0xFu;
-				if (hi >= 8u)
-					return n2a32_arm_mem;   /* extra load/store, LDREX/STREX, LDRD/STRD */
+		case 0:                          /* data processing register, multiplies, miscellaneous */
+			/* Extra load/store + synchronisation: bits 27-25==000, bit7==1, bit4==1.
+			 * bit 24 is NOT a discriminator here: it is opcode bit 3, so MOV/MVN/ORR/
+			 * BIC/TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN (DP register) also have it set. */
+			if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u)
+				return n2a32_arm_mem;
+			if ((insn & 0x10u) != 0) {
 				op2 = (insn >> 4) & 0xFu;
-				if (op2 == 5u)
-					return n2a32_arm_media; /* QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB */
-				if (op2 == 8u || op2 == 0xAu || op2 == 0xCu || op2 == 0xEu)
-					return n2a32_arm_media; /* SMLAxy/SMULxy/SMLAWy/SMULWy/SMLALxy */
+				if (((insn >> 23) & 0x1Fu) == 0x02u) {
+					if (op2 == 5u)
+						return n2a32_arm_media;
+					if (op2 == 8u || op2 == 0xAu || op2 == 0xCu || op2 == 0xEu)
+						return n2a32_arm_media;
+				}
 				if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x01200070u)
-					return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* BKPT */
-				if (hi == 2u && ((insn >> 16) & 0xFu) == 0xFu && ((insn >> 8) & 0xFu) == 0xFu &&
-				    (op2 == 1u || op2 == 3u))
-					return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* BX/BLX (register) */
-				return n2a32_arm_dp;        /* MRS/MSR, CLZ, other miscellaneous */
+					return n2a32_arm_misc;
+				if (((insn >> 20) & 0xFu) == 2u && ((insn >> 16) & 0xFu) == 0xFu &&
+				    ((insn >> 8) & 0xFu) == 0xFu && (op2 == 1u || op2 == 3u))
+					return n2a32_arm_misc;
+				return n2a32_arm_dp;
 			}
-			return n2a32_arm_dp;            /* data processing register, multiplies */
+			return n2a32_arm_dp;
 		case 1:                          /* data processing immediate, MOVW/MOVT, hint space */
-			if ((insn & 0x0FFF00FFu) == 0x03200000u)
+			if ((insn & 0x0FFFFF00u) == 0x0320F000u)
 				return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL */
 			return n2a32_arm_dp;
 		case 2:
 			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* load/store word or byte, immediate */
 		case 3:
-			if ((insn & 0x01000000u) != 0) { /* bit 24 */
-				if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x07F000F0u)
-					return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* UDF */
-				if ((insn & 0x10u) != 0)
-					return n2a32_arm_media; /* media multiply/divide (SDIV/UDIV/SMLAD/USAD8/...) */
-				return n2a32_arm_mem;       /* load/store register */
-			}
-			return n2a32_arm_media;         /* media: extend, bitfield, REV, SSAT, PKH, SEL, parallel add/sub */
+			if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x07F000F0u)
+				return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* UDF */
+			if ((insn & 0x10u) != 0)
+				return n2a32_arm_media; /* all media in this group have bit4==1 */
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;       /* LDR/STR register, P=0 or P=1 */
 		case 4:
 			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* LDM/STM */
 		case 5:
@@ -300,17 +300,23 @@
 	case 0xF3u:
 		return neon_route(insn);
 	case 0xF4u:
-		if ((insn & 0xFFF0F000u) == 0xF4D0F000u)
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF450F000u)
 			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLI (immediate) */
 		return n2a32_neon_ldst;             /* Advanced SIMD element/structure load/store */
 	case 0xF5u:
-		if ((insn & 0xFFF0F000u) == 0xF5D0F000u)
-			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLD/PLDW (immediate) */
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF550F000u)
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLD (immediate) */
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF510F000u)
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLDW (immediate) */
 		return n2a32_arm_misc;              /* barriers, CLREX, other unconditional */
 	case 0xF6u:
 	case 0xF7u:
-		if ((insn & 0xFFF00FF0u) == 0xF6D00000u || (insn & 0xFFF00FF0u) == 0xF7D00000u)
-			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLI/PLD (register) */
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF650F000u)
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLI (register) */
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF750F000u)
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLD (register) */
+		if ((insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF710F000u)
+			return n2a32_arm_mem;           /* PLDW (register) */
 		return n2a32_arm_misc;
 	case 0xF8u:
 	case 0xF9u:
```

If you prefer, apply only the case 0 hunk first: that one unblocks every ARM kernel (MOV/MVN/ORR/BIC/TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN currently go to arm_mem). The case 1 hunk unblocks YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/DBG, the case 3 hunk unblocks P=0 LDR/STR register, and the F4-F7 hunks unblock PLDW and the U=0 PLD/PLI forms.
